## Hello

I am a Master of Data Science student at the University of British Columbia. I came
here from computer science at National Tsing Hua University in Taiwan, where I spent
most of my degree on the systems side of machine learning — making large models run
faster on GPU clusters, and teaching other students how to do the same.

That work took me to three international student cluster competitions. My teams
placed 3rd at SC24 in Atlanta, 2nd at ISC 2024 in Hamburg, and 1st at the 2023 APAC
HPC-AI Competition, on problems ranging from MLPerf Stable Diffusion benchmarking to
an 11.4× speedup on BLOOM inference. Somewhere in the middle of optimizing other
people's models, I got curious about the models themselves — and about how much of a
reported result is real.

MDS is the other half of that education. I already know how to make a model run; I
came here to learn how to tell whether it should be trusted. I am looking for
**machine learning engineer** and **data scientist** roles where both halves matter.

More detail is on the [about page](about.qmd), my work is on
[projects](projects.qmd), and I write about the program on the [blog](blog.qmd).
